title: Sharp density conditions for infinite $B+B$ sumsets in abelian groups
summary: Motivated by recent results \cite{charamaras_kousek_mountakis_radic2025BBingroups} on infinite sumsets of the form $B+B=\{b_1+b_2:b_1,b_2\in B\}$ in large subsets of abelian groups, and an old problem of Owings \cite[Problem E2494]{Owing_problems} about the partition regularity of $B+B$ in $2$ colours, we show the following theorem. Let $(G,+)$ be a countable abelian group such that the subgroup $\{g+g\colon g\in G\}$ has finite index and the doubling map $D: g\mapsto g+g$ has finite kernel.
